notes: The method is versioned, but coefficients are refitted cumulatively whenever new paired Pasture + ERA5-Land days are available.
Temperature, RH and VPD use linear models whose coefficients are updated from all currently available paired daily observations.
Model selection is supported by leave-one-day-out cross-validation with a one-day temporal embargo; raw ERA5-Land values are always retained.
Model history is retained so coefficient evolution can be audited over time.
